meta.title: Coco the Pet Sheep
meta.textType: counting: numbers to twenty and plurals

paragraphs: Tom is at Grandpa's house. Grandpa has many sheep. "How many sheep are there?" asks Tom. They count the sheep. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine! Ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen! "Seventeen sheep," says Tom. "No, I have eighteen sheep," says Grandpa. One sheep is not here.

Grandpa and Tom look in the garden. Is the sheep on the grass? No, she is not there. "Coco!" says Grandpa. Coco is a small white sheep. She is Grandpa's pet. Now it is dinner. Grandpa and Tom go to the kitchen. Grandpa opens the door. "Look!" says Tom.

Coco is in the kitchen! She has some coconut in her mouth. She is very happy. "Coco, that is not your dinner!" says Grandpa. Tom smiles. Grandpa gives Coco some grass. "Eighteen sheep!" says Tom. Then they eat dinner. They have chocolate cake too. "It is nice!" says Tom.
text.summary: Tom counts seventeen sheep at Grandpa's house, but Grandpa has eighteen. Coco, the pet sheep, is in the kitchen.
